# Manus features overview

> Browse Manus features by category: workflows for organizing work, capabilities inside a task, web development, and reference pages for models.

Manus features are grouped in the same way as the sidebar. Each card links to the full page, with steps, limits, tips, and an FAQ. If you are new to Manus, start with the [Quickstart](https://manus.im/docs/introduction/quickstart.md).

## Workflows

Workflows help you organize, share, and repeat your work.

> [card] [Projects](https://manus.im/docs/features/projects.md)
>
> Keep shared instructions and files so that every new task starts with the right context.

> [card] [Manus Skills](https://manus.im/docs/features/skills.md)
>
> Give Manus a reusable set of instructions for a specific workflow.

> [card] [Automations](https://manus.im/docs/automations.md)
>
> Run a task on a schedule or when something happens in a connected app.

> [card] [Parallel Tasks](https://manus.im/docs/features/parallel-tasks.md)
>
> Split your work into separate tasks and manage them from one main task.

> [card] [Branch](https://manus.im/docs/features/branch.md)
>
> Take a task in a new direction from any reply. The original task stays unchanged.

> [card] [Manus Collab](https://manus.im/docs/features/collab.md)
>
> Work on a Manus task with your team in one shared workspace.

> [card] [Mail Manus](https://manus.im/docs/features/mail-manus.md)
>
> Send a task to Manus by email.

## Capabilities

Capabilities are what Manus can do inside a task, from research to slides, video, and browsing.

> [card] [Wide Research](https://manus.im/docs/features/wide-research.md)
>
> Use many agents in parallel for large research and processing tasks.

> [card] [Manus Slides](https://manus.im/docs/features/slides.md)
>
> Create a complete presentation from a description.

> [card] [Design View](https://manus.im/docs/features/design-view.md)
>
> Create designs with Manus and control each detail.

> [card] [Data analysis](https://manus.im/docs/features/data-visualization.md)
>
> Turn raw data into charts and insights that are ready to present.

> [card] [Multimedia](https://manus.im/docs/features/multi-modal.md)
>
> Generate and understand images, video, voice, and speech.

> [card] [Video Editor](https://manus.im/docs/features/video-editor.md)
>
> Make and edit videos on a multi-track timeline in Manus Studio.

> [card] [Meeting minutes](https://manus.im/docs/features/meeting-minutes.md)
>
> Turn a discussion into structured notes, then into a deliverable.

> [card] [Cloud browser](https://manus.im/docs/features/cloud-browser.md)
>
> Manus browses the web in an isolated browser in the cloud.

> [card] [Browser Operator](https://manus.im/docs/features/browser-operator.md)
>
> Let Manus work in your own browser, with the sites you are signed in to.

> [card] [Manus Studio](https://manus.im/docs/features/desktop.md)
>
> Let Manus work with the files, terminal, and apps on your computer.

## Web development

Build, publish, and manage websites, web apps, and games.

> [card] [Website Builder](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/getting-started.md)
>
> Build, preview, and publish a website or web app.

> [card] [Build locally](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/build-locally.md)
>
> Build websites, apps, and games in a folder on your own computer.

> [card] [Game Developer](https://manus.im/docs/features/game-developer.md)
>
> Create a browser game from a playable template and a description.

> [card] [Publishing](https://manus.im/docs/website-builder/publishing.md)
>
> Put your website online with Manus hosting.

To add a backend, payments, analytics, or a custom domain, open **Web development** in the sidebar.

## Reference

See which models Manus uses and how to use your own.

> [card] [Built-in models](https://manus.im/docs/models/built-in-models.md)
>
> See the video, image, audio, and 3D models that Manus uses.

> [card] [Nano Banana Pro](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/nano-banana-pro.md)
>
> Generate images for slides and graphics.

> [card] [Manus Flex](https://manus.im/docs/models/manus-flex.md)
>
> Run Manus with your own API key from a supported provider.

To connect Manus to other apps, see [Connectors](https://manus.im/docs/integrations/connectors.md).
